# PhotoFunia

> > PhotoFunia is a free online photo effects editor and filter service operated by Capsule Digital, offering creative photo transformations and effects.

PhotoFunia provides users with a wide range of photo effects and filters through its web platform and mobile applications (iOS, Android, Windows Phone, BlackBerry). The service allows users to apply creative effects featuring iconic locations like Times Square, NYC, Melbourne Gallery, and famous museums.
